title: Full-wave vertical ground rod characterization: data
description: Numerical data behind the article: L. Boukari and A. Bayadi, "When Is the Quasi-Static Image Enough? Validity Map and Accurate Sommerfeld Evaluation for Vertical Ground Rods," submitted to IEEE Access. Input impedance sweeps (10 Hz to 30 MHz) for 3 m and 30 m rods in 10, 100 and 1000 ohm-m soil with the exact Sommerfeld remainder and three quasi-static substitutes, 25-digit reference values of the remainder on the wire, mesh-convergence data, derived NEC-4.2 comparisons, permittivity checks and lightning ground potential rise under the IEC 62305-1 strokes. The source code is not publicly available.
